marker.coordinate_definition: The physical reference coordinate is the square's geometric center, manually aligned to the pen-tip projection. Only one red square is visible for each capture.

coordinate_convention.origin: The physical P0 mark on the paper plane.
coordinate_convention.x_positive: The previously verified GRBL X+ physical direction.
coordinate_convention.y_positive: The previously verified GRBL Y+ physical direction.
coordinate_convention.motion_precheck: From P0, commanded X+30 mm measured 30 mm physically; commanded Y+30 mm measured 30 mm physically. These checks establish this session's 30 mm axis scale but do not validate camera-plane correspondence.

reference_generation.p0: Pen returned to the physical P0 mark through verified reverse paths. User then aligned the square center to the pen tip before capture.
reference_generation.x30_y0: From physical P0, one persistent COM4 session executed six X+5 mm jogs at 100 mm/min; every segment returned ok and final Idle before the square was aligned to the pen tip.

incident.event: COM4 USB serial communication failed while waiting for completion of the first Y+5 mm segment from v2 X30Y0 toward v2 X30Y30.
evidence: pySerial raised Windows PermissionError 31 while reconfiguring write_timeout during the completion-status query.
The user observed a small physical motion before USB replugging.
After replugging, Device Manager still displayed USB-SERIAL CH340 (COM4), but Win32_SerialPort listed only COM1 and pySerial could not open/configure COM4.
incident.recovery_requirement: Do not resume a relative path from the current position. After COM connectivity is restored, physically realign the pen tip to P0 before any further motion or capture.

status: v2 calibration invalidated: a fresh, exposure-stabilized direct capture of the physically re-established P0 was approximately 75 pixels away from this file's P0 pixel. Do not fit or use v2 for display or motion.
